children: Bahrain’s Fuel Pricing and Monitoring Committee has announced approved fuel prices for September, effective from September 2, reflecting changes in global markets under the Kingdom’s pricing mechanism.
Prices are set at 0.225 ($0.60) Bahraini dinar per litre for Jayyid (91), 0.247 dinar for Mumtaz (95), 0.380 dinar for Super (98), and 0.229 dinar for Diesel.
The committee confirmed that diesel subsidies for Bahraini fishermen will remain in place.
It also said it will continue monitoring global market developments and take necessary measures to maintain balanced fuel prices in line with prevailing economic conditions.

title: ZAWYA: Bahrain announces September fuel prices
